audit.whatIsWrong: The page never calls out that Leona's Shield of Daybreak (Q) is an auto-attack-reset stun — the wind-up itself, not a cast animation, is the tell to step back from.
audit.why: Q resets her auto timer and stuns on the next hit; a reader watching for a 'cast' will miss the real signal, which is her attacking-into-the-reset animation.
audit.corrected: Folded the auto-reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns alongside the real cooldown numbers.
